scenes.headline: I thought good marketing meant saying more.
scenes.subline: More posts. More detail. More reasons to choose us.

scenes.headline: More information can create more hesitation.
scenes.subline: People do not need another wall of content.

scenes.headline: Clarity creates confidence.
scenes.subline: Show the process. Explain the trade-offs. Be honest.

scenes.headline: Make the next step feel obvious.
scenes.subline: The goal is not more content. It is a clearer decision.
